Weber contrast

Source: R/contrast.R
weber_contrast.Rd

Computes the Weber contrast: \((I_{target} - I_{background}) / I_{background}\). Positive values indicate a target brighter than its background; negative values indicate a darker target. Commonly used for isolated objects on a uniform background.

Usage

weber_contrast(I_target, I_background)

Arguments

I_target

Luminance or radiance of the target (scalar or vector).

I_background

Luminance or radiance of the background (scalar or vector). Must be non-zero.

Value

Contrast value(s); unbounded but typically in \([-1, \infty)\).

See also

[michelson_contrast()]

Examples

weber_contrast(I_target = 8, I_background = 4)
#> [1] 1
